decision: A for the single optional official garment-reference method in PLAN, not generation
reason: A current camp-collar short-sleeve garment example could clarify collar spread, sleeve opening and light woven visual language for a complete seasonal outfit. Actual existing references show a long-sleeve knit and cannot supply those new clothing details. We still deliberately author the new design; this is auxiliary front-visible style evidence, not hidden-part/physical/brand or character authority.

alternatives.choice: Use the one bounded optional official example method.
alternatives.tradeoff: May ground a concrete visible silhouette/material distinction; finite retrieval can fail and cannot qualify hidden geometry or fabric physics.

alternatives.choice: Keep all clothing details explicitly original-authored without external retrieval.
alternatives.tradeoff: Avoids another dependency and remains owned artist intent; has no external example witness.

scope: No critic reference-method opinion read; no online call or photo acquired. One query/page/photo only if independent/root worth agrees; no fallback.
